overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether object is a name-string vs. a Variable/Field reference); collapsed into one overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If specified, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable or a field.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

sentinelValues.meaning: No style sheet applied to the object for the current process
Automatic style sheet, used by default for all objects
Automatic style sheet for additional text in dialog boxes (static text, fields, and variables only)
Automatic style sheet for main text in dialog boxes (static text, fields, and variables only)

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Sets, for the current process, the style sheet (a named style sheet, an automatic style sheet, or none) applied to the object(s) designated by object and *.

constraints: If styleSheetName names a style sheet that does not exist, an error is returned (interceptable via ON ERR CALL).
If a style sheet was already associated with the object in Design mode, this command replaces it for the current process.

Subsequently changing the object's font or size via ST SET ATTRIBUTES, ST SET TEXT, OBJECT SET FONT, or OBJECT SET FONT SIZE automatically clears the style-sheet reference, even if the new attributes match the style sheet's; changing only the style (bold/italic/etc.) does not clear it in the same way.
